claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Doxapram is a respiratory stimulant that inhibits TASK-1/TASK-3 potassium channels at low micromolar concentrations, but this mechanism is not expected to produce meaningful cytotoxicity in a 5-day pooled viability screen; at 2.5 uM it is likely to be largely inactive or only weakly antiproliferative.
